author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal says a flaw in Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539), its online store module, is being actively exploited. Two merchants reported fraudulent order attempts, some priced at $0.01. Fixes: 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: LandscapeThreat
text: StyleSmuggler exploitation (CVE-2026-75650) deploys PSK Agent malware on Magento stores; IOCs include 0f851bdc9d.ddns.1433[.]eu[.]org and transfer.onlypsk.abrdns[.]com.

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild: missing-initialization flaw allows root-level access; CISA mitigation due 2026-10-31.

author: theomlondhe
text: Playwright 1.64.1 still downloads Chromium 156.0.8078.4, 69 builds before Chrome's Oct 27 fix for four criticals including a 9.6 sandbox-escape FileSystem bug, and chromiumSandbox defaults to false, exposing browsing AI agents.

author: morphisec
text: Citrix Confirms Two NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Exploited in Attacks — Shellcode Placed Directly Into Memory. Citrix confirmed CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 — both CVSS 9.5 — are actively exploited

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM Zero-Day (CVE-2026-94127) Actively Exploited — 14,700+ Instances Exposed, CISA KEV Added — unauthenticated RCE in BIG-IP APM's OAuth

author: LawrenceEng
text: WordPress has an actively exploited core bug: CISA added CVE-2026-119977 to KEV today. Attackers race the few seconds a full core update leaves files in wp-content/upgrade. Update to 7.1.4 (or your branch's fix) and block web access to that folder.

author: CveTodo
text: A remote code execution vulnerability in WordPress Core spanning more than a decade's worth of releases has been confirmed as actively exploited, with CISA adding it to KEV. #WordPress #RCE #KEV

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED, 10.0 rating. Missing-authentication vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on exposed hosts.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS): active exploitation confirmed. Apply Ivanti's October 29 security patches immediately. ACTIVELY EXPLOITED - CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw; CVE-2026-97229. CVSS 10.0 allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code through a malicious regular expression inside a CI/CD configuration.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell), both CVSS v4.0 9.2, are actively exploited unauthenticated RCE flaws in PHP core. CISA added CVE-2026-109618 to KEV on 26 October 2026.

author: morphisec
text: CISA: Ransomware Gangs Now Exploiting Critical TeamCity Auth Bypass (CVE-2026-63077) — CISA updated its KEV listing for this critical JetBrains flaw to flag active ransomware gang exploitation.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw can knock firewalls offline. CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload when SSL remote-access VPN is reachable. DoS, not RCE.

author: paul_fregonese
text: CVSS 10.0 and no authentication required. Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices are being actively exploited to drop remote command backdoors, per VulnCheck.

author: binarly_io
text: New Research: Pre-Auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 Exploited in the Wild as a Zero-Day. Linked to CVE-2026-7273 (KEV), however the patch did not stop the exploit.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Node.js October 2026 updates fix 10 flaws across 22.x, 24.x and 26.x, including the actively exploited critical Node2Shell Brotli flaw; also removes trust in eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates.

author: ESPProjects
text: Chrome users: A critical flaw was being actively exploited. Simply visiting a malicious webpage could put you at risk. Update Chrome now.

author: iamspiggle
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) — TCP / MPTCP Use-After-Free. Unauthenticated remote root code execution demonstrated via automated exploits.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability went undetected through multiple security audits. Hacktron AI found it in 10 minutes, in Dassault Systèmes' DELMIA Apriso, manufacturing software used by Boeing, Airbus, Lockheed Martin. It became CVE-2025-5086.

author: rst_cloud
text: An operator used the pentestcode AI agent against 25 mid-size and large European companies and reports breaching 10 of them (31-10-2026).

author: morphisec
text: Langflow's Critical RCE Flaw Hit With 1,423 Honeypot Exploit Attempts — CVE-2026-105740 (CVSS 9.9) lets any authenticated Langflow user achieve remote code execution by registering an MCP server with stdio transport

author: fireball_triada
text: Langflow: IBM's bulletin lists CVE-2026-93680 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-110186 (unauthenticated RCE through MCP tool enumeration). Upgrade is not the fix, the default is.

author: jondot
text: Copilot in Visual Studio couldn't edit its own .mcp.json. The check compared filenames, so a write to '.mcp.json.' passed, Windows dropped the dot, and a new MCP server ran. CVE-2026-103572, fixed in October.

author: D3bytes
text: A PDF Reader MCP server had an authentication bypass: it read MCP_API_KEY but never validated it. Unauthenticated clients could access the MCP endpoint. CVE-2026-62264

author: xcademialtd
text: AWS Flags Path Traversal Flaw in Serverless MCP Server; urges users to upgrade to version 0.2.1.

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato Botnet Installs the Hermes AI Agent on Hijacked Docker Hosts — worm-like botnet scanning for Docker daemons with unauthenticated APIs exposed on port 2375.

author: OpenMatter_
text: A contractor reportedly ran a personal AI agent on a Pentagon network for two months, and a tampered Claude Code add-on spent 11 hours in Cursor's store.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking is becoming a full-scale cybercriminal business: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant investigated incidents where criminals hijacked cloud AI access with stolen credentials and resold it.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Stolen cloud keys can fuel six-figure daily bills. Mandiant details LLMjacking; Kaspersky tracks CyberStrikeAI; Chainlit and AWS MCP have path flaws. Rotate keys. Validate MCP paths.

author: Michaelzsguo
text: Binance published a detailed RFO/RCA report on the October 29 cyberattack that resulted in $6.34 billion in stolen crypto assets. The attack started with a tampered developer tool and a fake job interview, then escalated through compromised laptops, internal AI tooling.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack lessons from Binance's $6.34B incident report: its timeline starts with a tampered Homebrew install of an AI coding tool.

author: NamanyayG
text: Oct 21: Railway detects attackers in systems storing customer secrets; deployments paused, every user told to rotate keys. 12 days later, Railway is back in the news over secrets.

author: joshmanders
text: They pulled credentials from inside their app's container and used them to request every secret on the platform: ours and every other customer's. They tried our cloud provider's metadata endpoint.

author: kryll_ai
text: SECURITY ALERT: GitBook, a docs platform, hit by AI-assisted breach. Users urged to rotate keys.

author: IonirixFirm
text: Attackers hijacked the update system of cPGuard, a server security tool, on Nov 2. Versions 5.88.12 to 5.88.19 shipped a backdoor and a data-stealing script. Vendor OpsShield says 2,946 servers were hit and its billing database was copied.

author: CisoMarketplace
text: NPM packages pulling 2 billion weekly downloads were hijacked in what researchers call the largest JavaScript supply chain attack on record. Phishing, stolen credentials, crypto theft.

author: morphisec
text: Silent Lynx Espionage Campaign: WinRAR + PowerShell + PS2EXE Chain Drops Custom Reverse Shells in CIS Government Networks (UAT-6275).
